title: Weak$^*$-weak points of continuity on the state spaces
summary: Let $X$ be a Banach space. For $x \in X$ with $\|x\| = 1$, we denote the state space by $S_x = \{x^* \in X^* : \|x^*\| = x^*(x) = 1\}.$ In this paper, we study weak$^*$-weak and weak$^*$-$\|\cdot\|$ points of continuity of the identity map on the state spaces in the space $\ell^p(X)$ for $1 < p < \infty$, where $X$ is a non-reflexive Banach space. We then use these results to characterize the weak and norm compactness of the state spaces of unit vectors in $\ell^p(X)$.
